summary: Lightspeed Commerce filed a Form 6-K furnishing its fiscal Q2 2027 earnings release for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Revenue was $323.8 million (2% as reported, 15% organic), gross profit $142.8 million, net loss $4.2 million ($0.03/share), Adjusted EBITDA $22.7 million. Results are distorted by the April 28, 2026 divestiture of Upserve, which management notes affects year-over-year comparability; organic figures adjust for it. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, price, or structural terms appear in the excerpt. Watch post-divestiture organic momentum and margin trajectory.
